annotation.interpretation_a: The clause means that if an endpoint receives a STREAM frame for a stream that is send‑only from the perspective of the endpoint that created it (i.e., a uni‑directional stream), then it must terminate the connection.
annotation.interpretation_b: The clause means that if an endpoint receives a STREAM frame for a stream that it has marked as send‑only (i.e., it will not receive data on that stream), then it must terminate the connection.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify which endpoint’s perspective defines the stream as send‑only, leading to two materially different implementation behaviours.
